name: Loki
notes: WunderCorp's open-source agent that keeps project memory between sessions, turns recurring procedures into reusable skills, runs scheduled jobs and reaches you over Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp or Signal. Self-hosted, so on the board as a stretch product. Requested via the form (issue #156).
tagline: The agent that evolves with you

access.price: Free, MIT-licensed; bring your own model key and server
